# ORG128 - no-section-number-prefix

Tags: organization, conversion, headings
Severity: info

Description: Section titles should not contain literal generated-number prefixes.

Necessity: Converted documents can preserve generated numbering in section titles. If Asciidoctor also generates section numbers, readers may see duplicate or stale numbering such as `1.2 1.2 Overview`.

Rationale: This fixture demonstrates an experimental custom rule for conversion cleanup. It is not an official extension pack rule; it exists to prove custom rules can express this class of AsciiDoc policy.

Bad:

What's wrong: The section title includes a literal counter that should be generated by the renderer when numbering is enabled.

```asciidoc
== 1.2 Overview
```

Good:

Expected: The title contains only the semantic heading text and leaves numbering to Asciidoctor.

```asciidoc
== Overview
```

Implementation note: This fixture uses parsed section titles and flags titles beginning with dotted numeric prefixes.
